name: house-t1-b-desert
description: Daub House, the desert look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Daub House drawn again as a little kasbah: a two-storey mud block with a tower at every corner, a level coped parapet, an arched door niche under a lattice oriel, beam ends, a terracotta frieze, and the kitchen under a Nubian mud vault. MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. 'build' writes a candidate.
